comments.body:
I‘m 2. semester CSE and I‘m in the same course as you. The Ana I part of the exam will be written by Prof. Riviér so you can safely assume it will be pretty similar to the old exams. As for Ana II we covered more theory then in the last years especially the submanifold part. 

In Prof. Zilteners notes there are two books referenced [DK04a] and [DK04b] wich have combined 300 pages of exercises, including on submanifolds.  I‘ll be grinding a couple of those especially for the submanifold exercises. You can download these for free on the ETH library website.  

The prof also mentioned that the exam will heavily focus on the stuff in the exercise (though I would guess a little easier). So my plan is to initially focus on the theory in the exercise and then later grind in the books I‘ve mentioned and old exams.
